data.name: Ide
data.gender_notes: Ide is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A form or idea which is conceived in the mind and then brought into reality. The name Ide carries the meaning “Idea, Concept” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ide usually hope their child will grow to embody idea, concept and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine inspiration and the power to create.
data.etymology: Ide belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Idea, Concept.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ide total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: אידה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אידה הוא שורש עברי שפירושו 'זרע קדוש' או 'עוזרת אלוהים'. הוא קשור למילה 'עדה' שפירושו 'עוזרת' או 'קדושה'. השם אידה מופיע בתנ'ך ככינוי לאחת מנשותיו של עזרא, כפי שנכתב: 'וְאִידָה בֶּן-טוֹבִיָּה' (עזרא 10:35). השם אידה נושא משמעות רבה בתרבות היהודית והוא משמש כסמל לנשים שומרות מצוות וקדושות.

in_greek.name: Ίδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὁ ὄνομα Ίδη εἶναι ἕνα ὄνομα πού προέρχεται ἀπό τήν ἑβραϊκή λέξη 'עדה' (עדה) πού σημαίνει 'μάρτυς' ἤ 'ἡ ἄγιος'. Στήν Καινή Διαθήκη, δέν ὑπάρχουν ἀπευθεία ἀναφορές στό ὄνομα Ίδη, ἀλλά ἡ ἔννοια τῆς εὐσεβείας καί τῆς ἁγιότητος εἶναι θεμελιώδης γιά τούς Χριστιανούς. Τό ὄνομα Ίδη ἦταν κοινό στήν ἀρχαία Ἐλλάδα καί εἶχε συνδέσει μέ τήν ἱστορία τῆς εὐσεβείας.

in_latin.name: Ide
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ide originem habet ex hebraico 'עדה' (adah), quod significat 'testis' vel 'sancta'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Ide non invenitur directe in scripturis, sed notio sanctitatis et auxiliatrix Dei fundamentalis est Christianis. Nomen Ide fuit usitatum in cultura Latina et habuit connexionem cum historia sanctitatis et virtutis.

in_english.name: Ide
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ide originates from the Hebrew root 'עדה' (adah), meaning 'adornment', 'beauty', or 'noble one'. It is associated with the concept of 'holy' or 'God's helper'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Ide carries significant spiritual meaning in Christian tradition, symbolizing a person of virtue, piety, and devotion. Historically, the name Ide has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its universal appeal and timeless significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ide" embraces the power of creativity and the practical implementation of ideas. It symbolizes the ability to bring thoughts and dreams into tangible existence, reflecting the ingenuity and resourcefulness that have characterized human advancement in various fields of technology, arts, and sciences. The name "Ide" can inspire people to conceive innovative solutions to the challenges that confront their communities and bring positive change to the world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Ide" can be seen as a reminder of the divine creativity and inspiration that is inherent in each person. According to Christian belief, this creative power comes from God, who is the ultimate origin of all ideas and innovations (1 Corinthians 2:13). The name "Ide" can serve as an inspiration for believers to trust in God's guiding hand and seek His wisdom and direction as they bring their creative ideas to fruition. The name can also serve as a reminder of the importance of bringing spiritual ideas to life through acts of faith, love, and service to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ide, meaning "Lord" in the Etruscan language, symbolizes the deep reverence and devotion to the Christian God. It serves as a constant reminder of our faith and trust in His divine guidance and power.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ide was a Christian martyr in the 3rd century. The name Ide carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ide was a slave girl who was martyred for her faith in Rome.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Ide continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
